overal.goal: Layer 1 of agent containment: prevent agents from using keyless local-trust access to boof and keep runner credentials and the data root out of their reach. Agents use browser-only keyless access, MCP keys, no agent credential plus marker, and a data root with mode 0700. OS-level sandboxing is a separate follow-up in agent-containment-layer-2.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md (Security model) and docs/boof-runner.md (Agents are not sandboxed) before changing anything.
Write the investigation up as docs/superpowers/specs/<date>-agent-containment-design.md and get the owner's choice before building.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check . && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not describe an allowlisted environment or MCP isolation as a sandbox; say what is and is not blocked.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Raised by the security review on 2026-11-02 (a task agent can call the local API as the administrator under local-trust); not started. Step 1 is the investigation of the four options.
Layer 1 (owner decision 2026-11-07): browser-only keyless access, MCP keys, no agent credential plus marker, data root 0700. Layer 2 (OS sandbox) not started.
Layer 1 closed: browser-only keyless access, MCP keys, no agent credential plus marker, and data root mode 0700. OS sandbox work is tracked separately in agent-containment-layer-2.

tests.strategy: An agent started by the runner cannot connect to the boof port and cannot read the data root, and can still write its worktree and reach its model API; checked per platform the chosen option supports.
